sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('21a2bb1d-d91d-4f99-97dd-cc67fe99a090') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

rows.establishment: FAREVA Unterach GmbH for Sandoz Inc.
